title: Spatial and regulatory organization of cell identity across the primate subcortex
title_zh: 灵长类下皮层中细胞身份的空间与调控组织
abstract: Mammalian brain cell identity is shaped by intrinsic factors and external context. We present a spatially resolved transcriptomic and gene regulatory atlas of cell types across all subcortical regions in a primate, the common marmoset. Dense sampling and cross-species integration revealed spatially precise neuronal assemblies, including ones in complex midbrain and diencephalic structures. Chromatin accessibility and transcriptional identity are spatially tuned within and across subcortical structures; spatial gradients within hippocampal subfields are orchestrated by graded transcription factors acting through graded enhancers. The primate-expanded thalamic γ-aminobutyric acid (GABAergic) population shares transcriptional and regulatory syntax with conserved midbrain populations, reflecting an evolutionary adaptation compared with rodents. Similar regional expression across cell types can arise by distinct regulatory architectures, as observed in telencephalic astrocytes and neurons. Conversely, distant cell types can share regulatory programs despite divergent identities: striatal GABAergic spiny projection neurons and telencephalic glutamatergic neurons share a postsynaptic regulatory program despite divergent lineages, regions, and neurotransmitter identities.
abstract_zh: 哺乳动物脑细胞身份由内在因素和外部环境塑造。我们呈现了一份针对灵长类（普通小帽猴）所有皮层下区域细胞类型的空间转录组与基因调控图谱。密集采样和跨物种整合揭示了空间精确的神经元组装，包括复杂中脑和间脑结构中的组装。染色质可及性和转录身份在皮层下结构内部及结构间具有空间特异性；海马亚区内的空间梯度由梯度转录因子通过梯度增强子调控。灵长类扩展的丘脑γ-氨基丁酸（GABA能）种群与保守的中脑种群共享转录和调控语法，与啮齿类相比反映了进化适应。相似的区域表达模式可在细胞类型间由不同的调控架构产生，如观察到的大脑皮层星形胶质细胞和神经元。相反，远位细胞类型尽管身份各异，可共享调控程序：纹状体GABA能棘状投射神经元与大脑皮层谷氨酸能神经元尽管血统、区域和神经递质身份各异，却共享突触后调控程序。
